title: SOC 2 Renewal: Year-Two Cost, Timeline and Changes
summary: A SOC 2 renewal audit through Agency starts at $2,500 in 2026. What repeats in year two, when to start, and a month-by-month calendar.
body_markdown:
## What does a SOC 2 renewal cost in year two?


Year two has fewer line items than year one, and the ones that remain recur every year. The table sets each line against year one and shows Agency's published price where one exists.


What does a SOC 2 renewal cost in year two? — comparison Line item Year one Year two Agency's published price Source


Program build: policies, control setup, first evidence library One-time work Not repeated Part of the first-year program[Express Comply pricing](https://getagency.com/lp/express-comply-pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=soc2&utm_content=soc-2-renewal__in_text)


Program operation: evidence, access reviews, vendor reviews Starts partway through the year Runs all year Express Comply renews at the then-current flat rate for your headcount band[Express Comply pricing](https://getagency.com/lp/express-comply-pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=soc2&utm_content=soc-2-renewal__in_text)


Independent audit First examination New examination of the next period Renewal audit from $2,500 for eligible companies[Renewal offer](https://getagency.com/soc-2-renewal?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=soc2&utm_content=soc-2-renewal__in_text)


Penetration test One test A new test and a new report $5,000 fixed for one web app[Pen test pricing](https://getagency.com/pen-testing/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=soc2&utm_content=soc-2-renewal__in_text)


GRC platform subscription (varies by vendor and headcount) Annual subscription Renews Not required; Agency runs programs with or without one No figure


Client hours Highest during the build 25% to 40% fewer than year one when Agency runs both the program and the audit (Agency's estimate) Not priced Agency data


The $2,500 starting price is promotional and applies to eligible companies with 1–10 employees seeking a Security-only Type 2 renewal with a standard audit scope, per[the renewal offer](https://getagency.com/soc-2-renewal?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=soc2&utm_content=soc-2-renewal__in_text) . Larger companies, additional Trust Services Criteria and penetration testing are quoted from your request.


One public record shows how a renewal fee behaves. Kentucky's state IT agency contracted a Type II audit for $49,800 ([March 2024 contract list](https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/moreinfo/Contracts/2004%20Keifer%20Data%20Base/PSC/240300.pdf) ), renewed for two years at $99,600, the same annual fee ([July 2024 list](https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/moreinfo/Contracts/2004%20Keifer%20Data%20Base/PSC/240700.pdf) ), then added $37,200 when it expanded the scope for year two ([June 2026 amendment list](https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/moreinfo/Contracts/2004%20Keifer%20Data%20Base/PSC%20Amendments/260600.pdf) ). The fee held when the scope held and rose when the scope grew. That is a large public agency.


In Agency's opinion of the market, the same renewal scope costs about $8,750 elsewhere, against its own $2,500 offer ([renewal offer](https://getagency.com/soc-2-renewal?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=soc2&utm_content=soc-2-renewal__in_text) ). Ask your current auditor for the renewal fee in writing before the period ends, and compare it against a quote for the same scope.


## When should you start the renewal?


Start before the current observation period ends. A Type 2 report covers a specific period, so the cleanest renewal begins the next[observation period](https://getagency.com/glossary/observation-period?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=soc2&utm_content=soc-2-renewal__in_text) the day after the last one ends. The standard does not fix the period's length: the Journal of Accountancy notes "there is no generally accepted minimum useful period that a report needs to cover" ([Journal of Accountancy](https://www.journalofaccountancy.com/issues/2011/jul/20103500/) ). Buyers fix the rhythm instead.


A 2026 Tennessee state contract, for one, makes its vendor "subject to an annual engagement by a CPA firm" for a SOC 2 Type II examination ([Tennessee contract](https://capitol.tn.gov/Archives/Joint/committees/fiscal-review/contracts/2026/10-28-26/05.%20DHS%20(EMS%20LINQ,%20LLC)_91921_Redacted.pdf) ). Three decisions have to be made before your period ends:


1. **Auditor.** Stay or switch. Either way, sign the engagement letter before the new period starts so the auditor agrees to the period and the criteria.
2. **Scope.** List what changed since the last report: new products, infrastructure, vendors and added criteria. Scope changes found during fieldwork are the expensive kind.
3. **Operating owner.** Name who runs the evidence calendar this year. Controls that lapse in month two become exceptions in the report.


Across Agency's renewal audits, the median time from the end of the period to the delivered report is about the same as for a first report. Customers will ask for something in that interval, which is what a[bridge letter](https://getagency.com/glossary/bridge-letter?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=soc2&utm_content=soc-2-renewal__in_text) is for.
